pool: Historical matched900 DarkBay images, not the later600-image reserved evaluation pool
temporal_rule: For A and B separately, independent case-sensitive per-position modes across every eligible epoch; self-votes included; retain all tied modes; accept any tied mode. Average A and B agreement fractions to choose one shared epoch.
length_rule: Per image use maximum observed prediction length across eligible A/B predictions. Missing positions are explicit null votes, never silently dropped or filled from labels; no edit alignment or target-length constraint.
ab_rule: Exact full-string A/B agreement at the same epoch divided by900
combined_rule: 0.5 * temporal character agreement fraction + 0.5 * exact A/B agreement fraction
limitations: Retrospective experiment after historical accuracy inspection
A/B and epochs have correlated errors
Different numbers of available epochs: Model1 epoch1 missing
Shared epoch selection for both readers; accuracy reported separately
